title: AI Full-Process Low-Code Middle Platform Based on the ‘1+1+3+N’ Architecture
summary: China Telecom HongXin describes an internal low-code platform for developing AI applications across transport, governance, and environmental monitoring.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The platform provides infrastructure for building and deploying AI applications, including road, intrusion, waste, and fire monitoring. Its testbed is internal and part of broader product development. The source describes intended service and development benefits without a measured deployment improvement.
purpose: Lower the effort required to develop and deploy sector-specific AI applications.
system: AI Full-Process Low-Code Middle Platform Based on the ‘1+1+3+N’ Architecture
developer: China Telecom HongXin Information Technology Co., Ltd.

ratings.reason: The low-code platform lists transport, governance, and monitoring applications without measured deployment outcomes.
Traffic safety and reduced environmental waste are general capability claims, not documented events.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 1: AI Full-Process Low-Code Middle Platform Based on the ‘1+1+3+N’ Architecture

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: A low-code AI platform supports monitoring applications
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
